title: Utility bills and energy usage data; state-owned facilities.
bodyText: The Hawaii state energy office shall collect all utility bill and energy usage data for state-owned facilities monthly and shall make this information available in a publicly accessible format.
bodyHtml: [§196-32]  Utility bills and energy usage data; state-owned facilities.  The Hawaii state energy office shall collect all utility bill and energy usage data for state-owned facilities monthly and shall make this information available in a publicly accessible format. [L 2022, c 239, pt of §2]
